name: doc-chat
description: Doc chat in every session: read a PDF, HTML or Markdown doc beside the conversation, pick a passage and ask Sonnet what, why or how, without touching the session's own conversation

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that answers questions about a doc

effort.title: How hard it thinks
effort.description: Higher is slower and costs more, and helps with maths and tricky whys

background.title: About you
background.description: What the answers can assume you know
background.default: An engineer comfortable with Python and the basics of machine learning. Wants the AI and ML ideas underneath: architectures, the maths, why a technique is used and what the alternatives were, and the research it comes from.

folders.title: Where to look for docs
folders.description: Folders the doc list searches, separated by commas; empty means the session's folder

autoOpen.title: Show the widget in every session
autoOpen.description: Open the Doc chat widget when a session starts; off, open it with /doc

watchClipboard.title: Pick up copied passages
watchClipboard.description: While the widget is on screen, text you copy from the open doc shows up as the passage to ask about. Copied text that is not in the doc is never used or sent
